comment: PROF MOTRO ROCKS. I had sex mindfulness and the law and I am so glad I had her for FYS. Lots of reading/discussion on it but very inspirational, not a ton of writing until the last paper (10+ pages) where we do in-class workshops which is nice. Also meditation in class which I liked a lot. She's serious about her work and is willing to meet. Love.

I had Motro for the FYS "Sex Mindfulness and Law." Her class setup was a bit unorthodox (we meditated at the beginning of every class) but I really enjoyed it. Would definitely recommend taking from her. You're not forced to participate in discussions so as long as you show up, listen and email you assignetments, it's an easy A.
She is a fantastic professor for a first year seminar.  I would absolutely take her class again.  Both the content of the class and her teaching style were inspirational.
Hard, challenging class. Great professor--cares tons about students learning material. Makes tax accessible.  Nice person, entertaining.
